title: The Networking Trap
hook: Stop "building your network." It’s a waste of time.
script:
(Visual: Split screen. Left side: Person frantically exchanging LinkedIn profiles at a mixer. Right side: Person deeply focused on a high-impact project.)

Voiceover: Most Indian professionals are obsessed with "networking." They collect contacts like Pokémon cards, believing that "who you know" is the key to the C-suite. 

But let's apply first principles. What is a professional relationship? It is an exchange of value. 

If you have no rare skill, your "network" is just a list of people who don't have a reason to help you. 

Stop attending mixers. Stop sending "Coffee Chat" requests to strangers. 

Instead, build a "Proof of Work." Create something so undeniable that the network seeks you out. 

The most powerful network isn't built by talking; it's built by being the person who can actually solve the problem.
caption: Your network is a lagging indicator of your competence. Stop chasing people and start building leverage. #RationalThoughts #CareerGrowth #FirstPrinciples #IndianProfessionals
